note: The fuzzer passes the PoC bytes as an in-memory SFNT font to FreeType.
During face initialization, the SFNT loader parses the optional CPAL table from the attacker-controlled font.

code:
face->palette_data.num_palette_entries = FT_NEXT_USHORT( p );
    face->palette_data.num_palettes        = FT_NEXT_USHORT( p );
note: The CPAL header supplies palette counts used later to advance the parser cursor.
A version-1 CPAL table enables parsing of the extension offset fields.
The cursor skips the color-index array using the untrusted palette count without first checking that the CPAL table contains that array plus the following three ULONG offsets.
The parser reads the first CPAL v1 extension offset from the advanced cursor; for the PoC the cursor is beyond the extracted CPAL table, producing a heap-buffer-overflow read.
